name: Snowyowl
introduce:
HR-300X 雪鸮
由地平线主导研发的新锐中型维修与支援机兵，目前仅配发极少量部队进行实战测试与数据收集。
为了有效支援高强度机兵作战，使自身产品线更契合当今作战体系，地平线确立了HR-300X多功能支援机兵的开发计划，并最终完成了代号「雪鸮」的先行试验机。在这一型机兵上，地平线舍弃了历来侧重的高精度与爆发火力，转而将重心放在装甲载荷、机动协调性以及战术数据链上，并设置十五组自动演算元件进行实时高效的最优配置。这一系列设计使该机拥有卓越的可持续作战能力，同时也可实时监控战场信息，向复数友军作战单位提供高效的维修与支援。

20524.name: Watcher Mod
20524.SpecificEffects: After active repair, grants <buf ID=7100305>[DMG UP III]</buf> to all targets, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. If the target already possesses [DMG UP] buff, increases the buff level by <color=#F74848>1</color>, up to <buf ID=7100309>[DMG UP 5]</buf>.

30428.name: Life Support Mod
30428.SpecificEffects:
When executing active repairs, increases repair AMT by <color=#F74848>12%</color>, with an additional <color=#F74848>24%</color> to the lowest HP part.
When this unit or their summon unit suffers overdamage, they will not be destroyed. After combat, restores HP to all allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles for <color=#F74848>30%</color> of their max HP. This effect can trigger up to <color=#F74848>1</color> times per battle.
